svg.title: FloorSync backend component diagram

text.tspan: Validates requests and enforces role checks
Queues runs and reads their results
Simulation event log and durable outbox
Celery tasks / results and socket tickets
Scope: API internals. Scheduling solvers execute in the separate Celery worker, reached through Redis.
